detail: dsh-web-mobile-fix: pinned to the registry's latest, 1.0.6, so pnpm's fresh-release hold cannot substitute an older version silently
dsh-web-mobile-fix: 1.0.6 is younger than this profile's minimumReleaseAge — installing the version pnpm admits instead; the update check will offer 1.0.6 once it is old enough
a too-young release blocks pnpm's lockfile verification (#39) — retrying once with --config.minimum-release-age=0
